title: אומנים ה"ה בה' פקדון ה"ה אות י"ו:
hebrewTitle: אומנים ה"ה בה' פקדון ה"ה אות י"ו:

segments.he: הלכות שוכר הלכה א נכלל בהלכות פקדון הל' א' ובה' אומנין הל' א' אות ד':
segments.en: And to explain a little, it is possible to say regarding the matter of the seventy doubled cries over a person's livelihood, the aspect of "double the pains of a woman in labor" mentioned above: that all the hashpa'os are drawn from the da'as, the aspect of: "if you lack da'as, what have you acquired? If you have acquired da'as, what do you lack?" — as our Sages of blessed memory said (Nedarim 41). And as it is written: "and through da'as are the rooms filled" (Mishlai 24:4). That is, the Torah, which is the da'as — from there all the hashpa'os and wealth are drawn. And the essential wealth is from the aspect of s'mol [left], as it is written: "in her left hand is wealth and honor" (Mishlai 3:16), in the aspect of: "from the north comes gold" (Iyov 37:22).
